lines.text: Darius appoints 120 satraps and three administrators, and Daniel stands out so much the king plans to set him over the whole kingdom.
The officials ask the king to decree that for thirty days anyone who petitions any god or man except him goes into the lions' den, and Darius signs it.
Daniel learns the decree is signed and still kneels three times a day in his upper room, with windows open toward Egypt.
Daniel is thrown into the den, a stone is sealed over it, and the king spends the night fasting in his palace.
Daniel tells the king that God sent a prophet to shut the lions' mouths, and he is lifted out unharmed.
